title: Fix City Lod Vector Tile Quadrant Edges
description: At city LOD, vector tiles show visible quadrant/tile edges. Enable land backdrop fill at city and finer LOD bands to hide tile seams.
summary: Blue quadrant stripes were chords from `close_path()` after polygon ring seam-skipping: skipping tile-bbox edges left open subpaths that were incorrectly closed with a straight line across each tile (teal/cyan, visible on light water). Reverted polygon fills to normal closed rings (fills already seamless via viewport backdrop + opaque base). Kept line-layer seam culling; added skip for entire boundary/waterway polylines whose points all lie on the MVT tile bbox.
